reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM sales
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC, product_id
LIMIT 3
